build_async_action_predictor: build an AsycnActionPredictor with a config to run multi-GPU action prediction workers asynchronously
create_async_vis_worker: create an AsyncVis instance with a video visualizer and optional number of CPU workers
run_async_demo_pipeline: run an AsyncDemo pipeline that chains action prediction and visualization asynchronously
test_draw_predictions: test the draw_predictions function to render bounding boxes and action labels on video frames
review_async_predictor_shutdown: review the AsycnActionPredictor shutdown method to verify stop tokens are sent to all worker processes
